newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy seen posting larger group prft - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy seen posting larger group prft - paper.

text.p: Group net profit at Japan Energy Corp for the year to March 31, 1998 is expected to be double the company's forecast released earlier this month, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Friday.
The paper said that Japan Energy's 1997/98 group net profit would be 28 billion yen against the company's forecast of 14 billion yen and its actual 1996/97 group net loss of 46.28 billion yen.
A company spokesman declined to comment on Nihon Keizai's estimate.
Nihon Keizai attributed the higher earnings forecast to expectations that Japan Energy's U.S. units would be able to collect loans extended to Encore Computer Corp in the United States.
The paper said that Encore had recently agreed to sell some of its operations to Sun Microsystems Inc, although Japan Energy said such an agreement had not yet been reached.
